# The Python packages the Dissidia tools import. tools/pydeps.py installs exactly these into tools/.venv/ the first
# time a tool needs them. Pinned on purpose: builds write into work/mods, which is tracked, and the same versions
# give the same bytes on every machine. Change a pin and the next tool run sets the environment up again.
# Each pin lists the sha256 of every wheel PyPI has for it, and pip installs nothing else (--require-hashes), so a
# changed or swapped download is refused. After changing a version run tools/pin_hashes.py to refresh the hashes.
